content.text:
I've read the release and the brief line by line. Here is my check.

**Key facts:** all ten are addressed and stated on the correct figure, period and basis. Two (f07 Cloud operating income, f10 buybacks) give the current-period figure correctly but omit the prior-year comparator the fact carries; nothing stated is wrong, so I score them as stated correctly.

**Claims:** the brief is almost entirely faithful to the release. Two items fail:
1. The "$69.9 billion of combined equity and debt proceeds" in Watch items is an analyst sum of the $49.6B equity raise and $20.3B notes — the release never presents a combined figure.
2. "Year-to-date acquisitions net of cash were $33,697 million" relabels a cash-flow line that is actually "Acquisitions, net of cash acquired, **and purchases of intangible assets**"; the release does not break out acquisitions alone, and intangibles rose from $1,283M to $9,105M over the period, so the attribution overstates deal spend.

Borderline but passing: the lead's "large majority of which came from a $99.0 billion net gain" — the release itself quantifies the after-tax net income effect at $77.1B against $112.1B of net income available to common, so the comparison follows from stated figures rather than a derived calculation.

facts.evidence: Revenues were $119,796 million, up 24% year over year, and up 23% on a non-GAAP constant currency basis.
diluted EPS was $9.11, up 294%
Google Cloud revenues rose 82% to $24,768 million, which management attributes to GCP growth across enterprise AI Solutions, enterprise AI Infrastructure and core GCP services
Google Services revenues were $94,540 million, up 15%
Income from operations was $40,770 million, up 30%, with operating margin of 34%, which the release says expanded by 2 percentage points.

Other income (expense), net was $97,983 million, including a net gain on equity securities of $99,031 million. The release states this gain increased the tax provision by $21.9 billion, net income by $77.1 billion, and diluted EPS by $6.26.
segment operating income was $8,814 million
Alphabet raised $49.6 billion in net proceeds from June equity and mandatory convertible preferred issuance

Q2 capital expenditures were $44,924 million and operating cash flow was $39,069 million; non-GAAP free cash flow was negative $5,855 million for the quarter and $53,273 million on a trailing-twelve-month basis.
Repurchases of stock were $0 in the quarter and year to date.
